figurative_meaning_en: unknown or suspicious persons, unspecified or random people
example_sentences_in_bangla: যাকে তাকে ঘরে ঢুকতে দেওয়া উচিত নয়।
যাকে তাকে বিশ্বাস করলে বিপদ হতে পারে।
example_sentences_in_english: You shouldn't let just anyone into your home.
Trusting random people can lead to trouble.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on selective hospitality and caution towards outsiders.
